name: RTECH
recent: RichTech Digital Berhad 于2026年9月29日召开第三次年度股东大会及特别股东大会，股东通过首次公开募股所得款项用途变更的决议。公司于2026年9月8日发布2026年年报，并于2026年11月25日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度的业绩。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过首次公开募股所得款项用途变更的决议。
第三次年度股东大会所有决议均以投票方式通过，包括批准董事薪酬及重选董事。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为161.6万令吉，环比下降5.4%，同比增长47.3%；净利为90.4万令吉，环比下降13.7%，同比增长87.9%；净利率为55.9%，低于上一季度的61.3%。

recent_en: RichTech Digital Berhad held its 3rd AGM and EGM on 29 September 2026, where shareholders approved the variation of utilisation of IPO proceeds. The company released its 2026 Annual Report on 8 September 2026 and announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026.
notable_en: Shareholders passed the resolution on the variation of utilisation of IPO proceeds at the EGM.
All resolutions at the 3rd AGM were passed by poll, including approval of directors' remuneration and re-election of directors.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR1.616 million, down 5.4% QoQ but up 47.3% YoY; net income was MYR904,000, down 13.7% QoQ but up 87.9% YoY; net margin was 55.9%, lower than 61.3% in the previous quarter.
